title: Bridge transition: EU morning shift — 2026-03-14
summary: Morning EU bridge transition. Two customer-impacting degradations (embeddings p99 and request queueing in dedicated pool) surfaced during the 04:00-08:00 UTC window. Both contained and mitigated; follow-ups and runbook edits recorded below.
incidents: INC-2026-0314-1: Embeddings p99 spike from 210ms -> 1.8s between 04:15-04:45 UTC. Root cause: transient Redis node GC pauses in prefix cache cluster eu-west-1. Symptom: increased KV latency and small retry storms from client-side backoff. Impact: ~12% of hosted embeddings requests saw 4xx/5xx retries and >1s latencies for 30 mins.

INC-2026-0314-2: Dedicated pool queue growth observed 06:10-07:00 UTC for customer DED-72. Autoscaler failed to scale due to stale label mismatch in HPA selector (recent infra rename). Symptom: request queue length rose to 350, 429s returned for non-critical background workloads; customer SLA at risk for peak batch jobs.

NearMiss-2026-0314-A: Alert flood from scheduled internal cluster maintenance (node reboot). Alert grouping suppressed after runbook throttle applied; no service disruption after auto-failover completed.
escalations: 04:25 UTC — Escalated INC-2026-0314-1 to Redis oncall (Luca) and Applied ML (Priya) due to model-serving cache dependency; join channel #infra-redis.
06:20 UTC — Escalated autoscaler issue to infra-platform (pager duty: infra-lead) because hotfix required cluster role update and rollout coordination.
07:10 UTC — Eng-ops manager looped in for customer comms for DED-72 (ownership: solutions-eng).
mitigations_and_timeline: 04:18 UTC — Added aggressive client-side retry smoothing (backoff jitter) as a temporary mitigation in the gateway for embedding endpoints.
04:30 UTC — Redis node restarted and moved out of rotation; read replicas promoted. p99 dropped back to 240ms by 04:42 UTC.
06:25 UTC — Rolled HPA label fix to dedicated pool staging, validated scaling behavior, then applied to prod at 06:40 UTC with zero-downtime rollout.
07:00 UTC — Queue drained to <20 after additional instances provisioned; alerts recovered.
07:30 UTC — Customer DED-72 notified of incident and mitigation steps; agreed to follow-up post-mortem and credits if post-mortem finds SLA breach.
